interpretation.mcp: Actual official SDK stdio roundtrip and unchanged native cache writes; each setting has a new process.
interpretation.native: Complete call, query-result cache disabled. Both bounded derived memos start empty and warm naturally.
interpretation.quality: Historical regression inputs; exact complete output equality, not new-domain or answer quality.
interpretation.resources: Fresh import/open/ingest/replay, process RSS/HWM and logical/main/WAL/SHM bytes separately recorded.
interpretation.source: Complete snapshots compared within each archive; six-table cross-archive projections omit only explicitly named host timestamps.
interpretation.timing: Fixed balanced source order, one host, no concurrent benchmark; retain first calls and every adverse sample.

competitor_comparison.fresh_selection: Deterministic ID-only selection of 256 Hotpot validation questions, excluding all 896 historical IDs, after full source/evaluator/model/input identities are frozen; verify actual exclusion union before selection
competitor_comparison.reporting: Retain all wins and losses, original native/component boundaries, all fixed token caps and no-answer cases. Do not claim whole-product or all-dimensions superiority from this component sample.
competitor_comparison.status: separate plan and source/evaluator/dependency freeze required before fresh selection or scoring
competitor_comparison.target: New same-boundary component comparison against pinned claude-mem FTS, ai-memory hybrid and billion-context kernel, including published Book baseline and final candidate

plan.correctness: Complete stable output must match for every query, config, engine and round. Exclude only native latency_ms. Verify source spans, exact tokenizer counts, scope, result limits, indexed content, MCP envelope and cache policy.

derived_cache_policy.natural_warmth: Each native book begins with empty derived memo; fixed subsequent configurations may naturally reuse counts. Each actual MCP configuration starts a fresh server process. Include first calls; no extra prewarming, selective clearing or response-result caching. Retain both sources memo diagnostics.

development.data_role: Historical inputs only; no fresh heldout scores for tuning
development.profiling: cProfile and deterministic operation-count diagnostics; retain reports, no speed gate or quality claim
development.repetition_rule: A complete development comparison runs once per materially changed frozen source; preserve failures and all adverse cells. A version-only edit is not a new optimization candidate.

plan.durability: Remote Git checkpoint this plan before product edits, then each completed implementation/audit stage. Freeze exact baseline/candidate/evaluator/input identities before scored timing. Exclusive per-binding execution claim, fsync per-call start/finish, worker start/finish remote checkpoints; preserve interruptions and failures. Final source must pass all nine CI jobs and package/public-installer gates before main/publication.
plan.failure_rule: Do not rerun completed formal measurements to select better samples, relax gates after outcomes, hide failed attempts, or claim speedup on a failed gate. A demonstrated correctness bug requires preserved failure evidence and a new explicitly documented candidate.

historical_compatibility.reference: The same 2304 historical Hotpot256 complete default-output hashes reproduced by published v0.3.3
historical_compatibility.rule: Full dependency/input/source preflight before recall. Exclude only latency_ms from payload equality; retain every original started/finished event and invariant.

implementation_hypotheses.proposal: Wrap the existing new-database schema statements in one explicit SQLite transaction, preserving complete schema and index contents, rejecting unrelated nonempty databases, retaining existing-archive migration behavior, and rolling back/closing on setup failure. Test interrupted schema setup and competing initialization before timing.
implementation_hypotheses.target: Startup and correctness of new empty archive creation

implementation_hypotheses.proposal: Use old-data profiles and call counts to remove repeated lexical normalization, scoring, token packing, metadata or source projection work. Preserve full public output, errors, source-map integrity, budgets, ranking, scope and custom-path fallbacks. Document each concrete candidate before comparing it.
implementation_hypotheses.target: Native and actual MCP recall work

implementation_hypotheses.proposal: If justified by dependency analysis, defer heavyweight archive/importer/integration imports until the selected command requires them, preserving public imports, help/version behavior and errors. Do not present CLI-only gains as full MemoryBook import gains.

formal.execution: Sequential isolated workers, one host, fixed shuffled query order per round/config; no concurrent benchmark. Native cache_size=0/use_cache=False; actual MCP result cache cleared before call outside timing, cache-write cost included.

plan.resource_review: All recorded startup, ingest/replay and RSS means retained. Increase over 10% requires explicit cause assessment and independent review; no automatic waiver.
plan.scope: Exact-output efficiency versus published v0.3.3 on historical regression data, plus startup/correctness improvements and a separately frozen fresh component comparison. Previous v0.3.3 accepted tradeoffs and earlier failed candidates remain immutable. No new-domain or generated-answer accuracy claim.

measurement.execution: Sequential isolated workers, one host, fixed shuffled query order per round/config; no concurrent benchmark. Native cache_size=0/use_cache=False; actual MCP result cache cleared before call outside timing, cache-write cost included.

binding.policy: One execution per source pair and stage, independent of binding filename; retain every sample and interruption.

measurement.execution: Sequential isolated workers, one host, fixed shuffled query order per round/config; no concurrent benchmark. Native cache_size=0/use_cache=False; actual MCP result cache cleared before call outside timing, cache-write cost included.
